ruff.command: python3 -m ruff check services/core/worker_progress.py tests/test_worker_progress.py tests/test_kernel_profile.py scripts/check-worker-progress-disposable.py

scope: aggregate active, queued, stale, and oldest-due values are validated
due backlog at/over a bounded threshold reports unhealthy
backlog below the threshold remains healthy
disabled queues are omitted from both SQL and response
invalid backlog configuration fails before database access
health output contains no queue row identifiers or payloads
Standard Compose configures the bounded backlog threshold
database_target: none; unit/profile tests use synthetic rows and repository files
